phase_history.details: Loaded skills (implementation-plans, session-lifecycle, context-packets), design doc (~1900 lines), codebase context, feature context, packages doc, resume prompt

Design grounded: 12 types mapped, 6 roles, 15 tools, 5 dispatch strategies, 30 verification criteria. All domain concepts mapped to codebase constructs. No context gaps — design doc is self-contained with exact code.

14 chunks proposed: 3 for Phase 1 (IPC+Sandbox), 3 for Phase 2 (Host+Container+REPL), 3 for Phase 3 (ptc_tools+Dispatcher), 2 for Phase 4 (Docker+MCP), 1 for Phase 5 (Error+Cleanup), 1 for Phase 6 (Skills), plus REPL pool extension
Wrote plain-text plan with full tasks, invariants, scope, out_of_scope, and design doc references per chunk
Converted plain-text to schema-compliant JSON. 14 chunks, 4 global invariants, quality gates, module_tests placeholder.

Test architecture complete: 259 tests across 14 chunks (240 Pass A, 11 Pass B, 8 Pass C). All 30 verification criteria mapped. 11 test files, 11 shared fixtures. Per-chunk handoff blocks with TDD red-phase instructions. Written to .claude/plans/ptc-test-specs.md

design_deviations.description: Split Phase 2 Container Manager into two chunks (core + REPL pool)
design_deviations.design_doc_said: Phase 2: IPC Host + Container Manager + REPL Pool as one phase
design_deviations.plan_instead: chunk-06 (Container Manager core) + chunk-07 (REPL Pool + Handoff) as separate chunks
design_deviations.reason: Container Manager has 9 verification criteria (15-23). Splitting gives better TDD focus: chunk-06 tests basic container lifecycle, chunk-07 tests multi-REPL and handoff independently.

design_deviations.description: Split Phase 3 ptc_tools into two chunks
design_deviations.design_doc_said: Phase 3: Tool Dispatch + ptc_tools as one phase
design_deviations.plan_instead: chunk-08 (ptc_tools direct-call: files, search, tokens) + chunk-09 (ptc_tools subprocess: testing, git, network) + chunk-10 (Tool Dispatcher)
design_deviations.reason: ptc_tools has 7+ files. Single chunk would exceed 4-file limit and be too large for one TDD session. Split by dispatch strategy (direct-call vs subprocess).

decisions_made.decision: 14 chunks total: 3 IPC/sandbox + 3 host/container + 3 tools/dispatch + 2 integration + 1 hardening + 1 skills + 1 REPL extension
decisions_made.reason: Balances TDD session size (30-60 min each) with dependency complexity. Each chunk delivers testable capability.

decisions_made.decision: chunk-01, chunk-04, chunk-08 are independent — can be implemented in parallel
decisions_made.reason: No dependency relationship between IPC protocol, event logger, and ptc_tools. Three-lane parallel start possible.

decisions_made.decision: chunk-14 (PTC Skills) has no code dependencies — can be done anytime
decisions_made.reason: Documentation-only chunk. Content comes directly from design doc. No need to wait for code.

decisions_made.decision: All Docker operations mocked in tests
decisions_made.reason: Unit tests must not depend on Docker daemon. Integration testing with real Docker is manual verification.

decisions_made.decision: Old tool_implementations/ kept for reference until chunk-13 cleanup
decisions_made.reason: Chunk-coders extracting ptc_tools need to reference existing fallback() implementations. Delete make_kernel_code in chunk-13, keep fallback() for reference.

decisions_made.decision: Pass C activated — multi-component IPC system with Docker, sockets, and concurrency
decisions_made.reason: Feature has external system deps (Docker), multi-stage pipeline (IPC→executor→dispatch→result), and concurrent execution. Pass C essential for E2E and error recovery validation.

decisions_made.decision: All async tests use @pytest.mark.asyncio — no manual event loop management
decisions_made.reason: IPC, executor, container manager are all asyncio-based. pytest-asyncio provides clean async test support.

decisions_made.decision: Pass B integration + Pass C system tests implemented during chunk-13 (hardening)
decisions_made.reason: Cross-chunk tests require all components assembled. chunk-13 is the hardening chunk where the full system is wired. Integration tests are created alongside error handling tests.
